newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian Sept output rises 3.2 pct, up 4.8 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Croatian Sept output rises 3.2 pct, up 4.8 pct y/y.

text.p: The Central Bureau of Statistics issued the following economic indicator details.
CROATIA INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT SEPTEMBER AUGUST SEPT '95
NOTES -- January-September output rise was put at 2.5 percent compared to a yaer ago period, up from 2.3 percent to August.
Data include estimates for Croatian territory held by separatist Serbs. Production in this area amounted to 5-7 percent of the total before 1991. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
